description: From plate cost and target food cost %, compute the net price, the price including VAT/sales tax, and the menu price rounded UP to a clean step (e.g. 0.50), plus real gross profit and food cost % after rounding.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code used only for formatting, e.g. EUR, USD, GBP

plateCost.description: total ingredient cost of one plate

roundTo.description: round the menu price up to this step, 0 for none

taxPercent.description: VAT / sales tax % included in menu prices (0 if prices are shown net)

name: menu_price_calculator
title: Menu price calculator (with VAT and rounding)
